title: Two Scoreboards
stamp: Perception is not proof. Either way.

scenes.text: Corruption perceptions, 2025: Brazil scores 35 out of 100. Rank: 107th of 182. World average: 42.
Trust, 2026: the Edelman index puts Brazil at 56 of 100. That’s above the US at 47, the UK at 44, Germany at 44, France at 42.
So “the least trusted country” isn’t what the numbers say. The honest line: perceived corruption is poor, institutions aren’t uniformly distrusted, and neither number proves a single case.
